description: Shadowflame - fel magic that banks its own fury and drops infernals when it crits.
_source_note: Rebuilt 6 Nov 2026 from the 38 real CoA Infernal talents (role DPS, caster). Shadowflame is a COMBINED school (['shadow','fire']) and _school_damage_bonus walks every component, so both shadow_spell_damage and fire_spell_damage apply to the spec's Shadowflame spells - verified live after wrongly calling arcane_spell_damage dead earlier the same day. CoA's Energy and Felfury collapse into our single felfury pool. Fel Infusion's party half is real only because the ABILITY was converted to target_type 'party'. Five talents die on 'while Inner Demon is active' and two on 'above 75% health'.

nodes.name: Wrath of Sargeras
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow and Fire damage by 6% and your hit chance by 3%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your Magic damage dealt by 3% and your spell hit chance by 2%.' PORTS EXACTLY, doubled. 'Magic damage' on this class means Shadowflame, which carries damage_school ['shadow','fire'] - and _school_damage_bonus WALKS EVERY COMPONENT OF A SCHOOL LIST (abilities.py:1358-1372, whose own comment says bailing out on lists 'meant a combined-school ability could never receive ANY school damage bonus'), so both keys apply to every Shadowflame spell and stack. Authoring the two separately rather than a combined shadow_fire_spell_damage key also means they reach the spec's pure-shadow abilities (sargeron_smite, bane_of_chaos) and pure fire (immolation_aura). hit_rating is live as a FLAT bonus in PERCENTAGE POINTS - it is only invalid as a CONVERSION target. The two school keys are FRACTIONS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Felfire Adept
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Sargeron Smite and Fel Fireball by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Sargeron Smite by 10%.' PORTS EXACTLY, extended to Fel Fireball, which four other nodes in this tree read. This spec keys off crits six times, so crit chance is its real currency. Per-ability crit keys are PERCENTAGE POINTS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Hidden Power
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage by 15% of your Intellect and 15% of your Spirit.
nodes._source: CoA level 20 passive: 'Increases your spell damage by 15% of your Intellect and Spirit. In addition, Inner Demon now increases your spell damage and critical strike chance by an additional 20% of your Spirit.' THE FIRST HALF PORTS EXACTLY as two conversions - spell_damage is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and both intellect and spirit are in SOURCES, so both pairs are legal. CoA gates this on INNER DEMON BEING ACTIVE, and nothing reads whether another effect is live. Dropped, with the value priced unconditional. Five Infernal talents carry this gate. Both FRACTIONS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Black Magic
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Bane of Chaos and Ruin by 12%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the damage of your Bane of Chaos and Ruin by 10%.' PORTS EXACTLY, both abilities, doubled. Bane of Chaos is a shadow spell_dot that generates 20 felfury; Ruin is the spec's Shadowflame nuke. Both FRACTIONS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Illidari Smiter
nodes.description: Your critical strikes generate 10 Felfury.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Fel Fireball now generate 1 Felfury.' PORTS ALMOST VERBATIM; only the Fel-Fireball scoping goes (no per-ability proc trigger). Folded in CoA's Doomsayer ('critical strikes with Sargeron Smite now refund 1 Felfury'), which is the same mechanic on a different ability - its second clause, +25% damage above 75% health, fails: CoA gates this on the target being ABOVE 75% health. high_health_damage_threshold_pct is DEAD DATA and there is no above-health conditional of any kind - only the below-health low_health_damage_pct added 6 Nov 2026. Dropped. CoA banks Felfury as a 0-5 point mechanic separate from the Energy it spends; ours is the single primary pool, so '1 Felfury' becomes 10 felfury - half what Fel Fireball itself generates. grant_resource's `amount` is FLAT; there is no pct_max field.

nodes.name: Nether Spirit
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 21% of your Spirit.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your spell critical strike rating by 20% of your Spirit.' PORTS EXACTLY - crit_chance_spell is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and spirit is in SOURCES, a legal pair that four other trees in this project already use. Spirit is this spec's secondary stat (Hidden Power converts it to spell damage too), so the two nodes compound. A FRACTION. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Illidari Magi
nodes.description: Your damaging spells have a 25% chance to generate 10 Felfury.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your periodic damage now has a 20% chance to generate 1 Felfury.' CoA FIRES THIS OFF DOT TICKS, which are not a trigger: status_effects.py:914 ticks a dot by calling the recipient's own take_damage with no caster reference, so there is nobody to fire a proc on. Re-pointed to on_damage_cast at 25%. This is the same loss eight Chronomancer talents, three Necromancer and two Ranger ones take, and it is the single most-repeated unbuildable trigger in the CoA data.

nodes.name: Cursed Flames
nodes.description: Your critical strikes increase your spell critical strike chance by 20% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critically striking with Fel Fireball now increases the critical strike chance of your next Fel Fireball within 10 seconds by 20%.' PORTS ALMOST VERBATIM - CoA's 20% kept - with only the two Fel-Fireball scopings widened: there is no per-ability proc trigger, and a status effect cannot carry a per-ability crit key, only the generic one. 10 sec -> 3 turns, and a 1-turn internal cooldown so it cannot chain off itself indefinitely. crit_chance_spell inside a status effect is PERCENTAGE POINTS, same as on the talent side.

nodes.name: Infernal Summoner
nodes.description: Your damaging spells have a 10% chance to reset the cooldown of Infernal.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Direct damage dealt now has a 5% chance to reset the cooldown of Infernal.' PORTS VERBATIM in shape - reset_cooldown WITH A BARE LIST is a full reset, as against the {abilities, turns} form which only shaves turns. 5% -> 10% with a 2-turn internal cooldown, because Infernal is a 15-turn summon and chaining resets off a caster's rapid casts would flood the field. felsworn_infernal IS a real summon_pet ability, so this genuinely produces a pet. CoA's Infernal Ruin ('every 3rd Ruin or Felwrath spawns an Infernal') cannot be built: there is no cast counter anywhere in the engine.

nodes.name: Malice of Gul'dan
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 60% chance to burn the target for 3 turns and restore 5 Felfury.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Direct critical strikes now have a 60% chance to trigger a Felstrike and generate a Fragment of Malice. Felstrike: burn an enemy for Shadowflame Damage over 6 sec, stacking 3 times. Fragment of Malice: restores 5 Energy and increases your critical strike chance by 10% for 5 sec.' PORTS UNUSUALLY WELL: the 60% chance, the 3-stack dot and the resource restore all build, with CoA's Energy being our felfury. A single proc can carry both a grant_resource and an apply_effect, which is why this one node does both halves. The Fragment's crit buff is dropped - Cursed Flames already supplies that window and stacking a second would double-count. 6 sec -> 3 turns. The dot is authored shadow rather than the combined ['shadow','fire'] because a status effect's damage_school is a single string.

nodes.name: Oppressive Ruin
nodes.description: Your damaging spells have a 30% chance to reduce the target's healing received by 25% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Ruin now absorbs the next 99 healing on the target based on rank, up to 226 at rank 7, for 8 sec.' A HEALING ABSORB ON AN ENEMY HAS NO MECHANIC - absorbs are caster-side proc payloads (shield_pct, absorb_pct_max_health) and cannot be applied to a target - so this becomes a percentage healing reduction, which is the readable equivalent: healing_taken_pct is one of only eight status stat_mods a monster reads. The Ruin scoping goes (no per-ability proc trigger). 8 sec -> 3 turns. PERCENTAGE POINTS inside a status effect (character.py:2904 divides by 100), so -25 is -25% and -0.25 would have been -0.25%. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Unphased
nodes.description: Increases your spell penetration by 21 and your Shadow and Fire damage by a further 6%.
nodes._source: CoA level 40 passive: 'Increases your spell penetration by 20, scaling with your level. In addition, reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 50% while Inner Demon is active.' The penetration PORTS EXACTLY: spell_penetration is a FLAT rating fed into a real attribute (character.py:1382) and read attacker-side by both Character and Monster take_damage against magic_resistance, so it works today - and it is one of the talents that will pay for Kyle's shelved per-school resistance system. Spell pushback does not exist as a mechanic, and CoA gates this on INNER DEMON BEING ACTIVE, and nothing reads whether another effect is live. Dropped, with the value priced unconditional. Five Infernal talents carry this gate. The level-scaling clause is dropped: talent effects do not scale with character level. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Fel Infusion
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 3% and reduces the cooldown of Fel Infusion by 36%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases critical strike chance of all party and raid members within 100 by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects. In addition, increases your critical strike chance by 3%.' THE PARTY HALF IS REAL BUT NOT FROM HERE: a talent effect can never reach an ally. The felsworn_fel_infusion ABILITY carries the party crit (crit_chance_physical and crit_chance_spell) and was converted from target_type 'self' to 'party' on 6 Nov 2026 - the same call Kyle made for Guardian's four auras on 5 Nov and that was applied to Reaper's two and Necromancer's three today. So this talent does what a talent can: CoA's own selfish 3% plus making that aura available more often. The does-not-stack clause has no mechanism short of every class's equivalent aura sharing an exclusive_group, which is a project-wide decision. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Sargeras Embrace
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Sargeras Embrace by 24% and its duration by 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Channel a beam of fel magic upon an enemy, slowing their movement speed by 60% for 5.5 sec and dealing Shadowflame Damage at the end of the duration.' The ability already exists as a 2-turn shadow spell_dot. CoA's channel, its slow and its end-of-duration payload are all unbuildable - there is no channelling, movement speed is not a mechanic, and no trigger fires when an effect expires - so the node boosts the dot we have. +2 TURNS IS +2 FULL-VALUE TICKS, not a dilution: abilities.py:2777 derives per-turn damage from the ability's OWN base duration, so the dot doubles from 2 turns to 4 at unchanged per-tick damage. SMALL INTEGER IN TURNS, so talent_ranks.spread() refuses to rank this node.

nodes.name: Gul'dan's Prodigy
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of Fel Fireball and Felwrath by 24% and increases Felwrath's damage by 24%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces Energy cost and cast time of Fel Fireball by -15%.' The cost half ports - CoA's Energy is our felfury, the single primary pool - and the cast-time half is dropped, since there are no cast times. Extended to Felwrath, CoA's 'Consumes 2 Felfury' AoE, whose own talents all key on Inner Demon and are therefore unbuildable. Fel Fireball generates 20 felfury, so cheapening it compounds. *_cost_pct keys are FRACTIONS where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Fel Cannon
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Ruin and Felwrath by 9%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Fel Fireball and Ruin by 15% on enemies above 75% health.' CoA gates this on the target being ABOVE 75% health. high_health_damage_threshold_pct is DEAD DATA and there is no above-health conditional of any kind - only the below-health low_health_damage_pct added 6 Nov 2026. Dropped. So CoA's 15% is kept unconditional - a straight buff relative to CoA, flagged rather than pocketed quietly, because the alternative was a node that silently never fired. Pointed at Ruin and Felwrath rather than Fel Fireball, which Felfire Adept already covers. Per-ability crit keys are PERCENTAGE POINTS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Shadow Magi
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Annihilation, Sunder and Ruin by 18%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Annihilation by -15 sec and Sunder by -4 sec.' PORTS EXACTLY in shape, with Ruin added as the spec's main nuke. Annihilation is a 8-turn self-buff and Sunder is an AoE with no cooldown in our data, so the percentages land differently than CoA's flat seconds - the key is proportional and there is no flat-seconds form. FRACTIONS where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION; talented_cooldown floors at 1 turn.

nodes.name: Withering
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Fel Fireball by 15% and your spell damage by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Fel Fireballs used with Felforged active now deal 30% increased damage.' Felforged is a cast-time proc ('your next 3 Fel Fireballs have a -30% reduced cast time') and there are no cast times, so it does not exist here - which means nothing can gate off it either. CoA's 30% is therefore kept unconditional on Fel Fireball, with a small global added. Fel Fireball is the spec's filler and a 20-felfury generator, so three nodes in this tree point at it. Both FRACTIONS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Felshock
nodes.description: Your critical strikes leave the target taking 8% more magic damage for 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Direct critical strikes with Felfury spenders now extend the duration of Inner Demon by 1 sec and cause enemies struck to have a 3% increased chance to be hit by spells for 12 sec.' TWO CLAUSES, BOTH REBUILT: no payload extends a LIVE effect's duration, and there is no recipient-side 'chance to be hit' key anywhere - the eight stat_mods a monster reads are armor, attack_power, damage_taken_pct, healing_taken_pct, magic/physical/spell_damage_taken_pct and magic_resistance. Repriced as magic damage taken, which is the same direction (more of this caster's damage lands) through a key that works, and raised to 8% since it replaces both clauses. 12 sec -> 4 turns. PERCENTAGE POINTS inside a status effect, and positive INCREASES damage taken, so 8 is right in both sign and magnitude - 0.08 would have been 0.08%.

nodes.name: Man'ari Teachings
nodes.description: Increases your critical damage by 100% and your Shadow and Fire damage by a further 10%.
nodes._source: CoA level 50 passive: 'Increases your critical damage dealt by 100%.' PORTS VERBATIM, which for a capstone of this size is worth noting - CoA really does double crit damage here. crit_damage_pct is read at abilities.py:1438 and is a FRACTION, so 1.00 is +100%; it stacks on top of CRIT_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER rather than replacing it. Paired with the tree's school theme so the capstone pays off everything below it: with Wrath of Sargeras and Unphased that is +21% to every Shadowflame spell, and this spec crits six different ways to cash the crit damage in. All three keys are FRACTIONS. Was a pure scalar on our side.
